tests: Looks up a named place, item of equipment or quantity in the building's model; refuses if it is absent, and asks which is meant if a name fits several places.
if_cannot_run: Before routing, the question goes on. In the data and capability lanes, it is refused and the person asked to try again.
ev4_text: refusing to assert rather than failing open

tests: An LLM judges whether the reply answers the question, not whether it is true. In \fv{relevance_lanes} lanes an off-target reply becomes a refusal, unless the turn produced one of the results listed in \S\ref{sec:sys-checks}.
if_cannot_run: The reply stands (time-out, \fv{relevance_timeout_s}\,s by default; provider error; unreadable verdict).

tests: A retrieved passage is quoted only if it shares a distinctive word with the question and covers enough of it; otherwise the lane declines.
In the template lanes, a number that is not in the lane's own results replaces the reply with a statement that a figure could not be checked.
A chart is drawn only from measured values; if one was asked for and none was drawn, the reply says so.
A reply that calls a value high or low, where the value is impossible for its quantity in any common unit, gets a note that it is probably unscaled.
A reply saying the building has no sensor of a kind is checked by a count in the graph and corrected if some exist; a count of zero for something the model does not hold is reworded.
